verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a static availability page stating that CPU machines are available in all datacenter regions, and the create flow lets you pick a machine type and region. Nothing documents a real-time view of GPU stock by type and region before provisioning; static regional listings and approval gates for high-end GPUs are adjacent, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
